mapper.sql: select s.stat_id, s.device_id, s.stat_date, s.total_runtime_hours, s.total_fault_count, s.total_maintenance_count, s.average_temperature, s.maximum_temperature, s.minimum_temperature, s.average_power, s.uptime_percentage, s.downtime_minutes, s.maintenance_cost, s.fault_rate_per_hour, s.remark, d.device_no, d.device_name from eq_device_stat s left join eq_device d on s.device_id = d.device_id
mapper.select: where s.device_id = #{deviceId} order by s.stat_date desc

SELECT CAST(NULL AS UNSIGNED) AS stat_id, d.device_id, NOW() AS stat_date, ROUND(IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.operation_type = 1 THEN o.operation_duration ELSE 0 END) FROM eq_operational_data o WHERE o.device_id = d.device_id ), 0) / 3600, 2) AS total_runtime_hours, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eq_fault_record f WHERE f.device_id = d.device_id), 0) AS total_fault_count, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eq_maintenance_record m WHERE m.device_id = d.device_id), 0) AS total_maintenance_count, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(e.device_temperature, e.ambient_temperature)), 2) FROM eq_environment_data e WHERE e.device_id = d.device_id AND (e.device_temperature IS NOT NULL OR e.ambient_temperature IS NOT NULL) ) AS average_temperature, (SELECT ROUND(MAX(COALESCE(e.device_temperature, e.ambient_temperature)), 2) FROM eq_environment_data e WHERE e.device_id = d.device_id AND (e.device_temperature IS NOT NULL OR e.ambient_temperature IS NOT NULL) ) AS maximum_temperature, (SELECT ROUND(MIN(COALESCE(e.device_temperature, e.ambient_temperature)), 2) FROM eq_environment_data e WHERE e.device_id = d.device_id AND (e.device_temperature IS NOT NULL OR e.ambient_temperature IS NOT NULL) ) AS minimum_temperature, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(el.active_power), 4) FROM eq_electrical_data el WHERE el.device_id = d.device_id AND el.active_power IS NOT NULL ) AS average_power, (SELECT CASE WHEN IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN x.operation_type = 1 THEN x.operation_duration ELSE 0 END), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN x.operation_type = 2 THEN x.operation_duration ELSE 0 END), 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN x.operation_type = 1 THEN x.operation_duration ELSE 0 END) / (SUM(CASE WHEN x.operation_type = 1 THEN x.operation_duration ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN x.operation_type = 2 THEN x.operation_duration ELSE 0 END)), 2) ELSE NULL END FROM eq_operational_data x WHERE x.device_id = d.device_id ) AS uptime_percentage, CAST(ROUND(IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o2.operation_type = 2 THEN o2.operation_duration ELSE 0 END) FROM eq_operational_data o2 WHERE o2.device_id = d.device_id ), 0) / 60, 0) AS SIGNED) AS downtime_minutes, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(m2.maintenance_cost), 2) FROM eq_maintenance_record m2 WHERE m2.device_id = d.device_id ) AS maintenance_cost, ROUND( IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eq_fault_record fx WHERE fx.device_id = d.device_id), 0) / NULLIF(IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ox.operation_type = 1 THEN ox.operation_duration ELSE 0 END) FROM eq_operational_data ox WHERE ox.device_id = d.device_id ), 0) / 3600.0, 0), 4 ) AS fault_rate_per_hour, 'COMPUTED_AGGREGATE' AS remark, d.device_no, d.device_name FROM eq_device d WHERE d.device_id = #{deviceId}
mapper.insert:
insert into eq_device_stat
stat_id, device_id, stat_date, total_runtime_hours, total_fault_count, total_maintenance_count, average_temperature, maximum_temperature, minimum_temperature, average_power, uptime_percentage, downtime_minutes, maintenance_cost, fault_rate_per_hour, remark,
